text:
Alex: dropped a new Figma for the compare table — compact rows show perf badges crowding the pin button and the row height collapses. screenshot: https://figma.redwood/compare-compact.png
Marcy: can you paste the compact & comfy screenshots here? the single link loses context.
Alex: added inline images (compact / medium / comfy). compact is what big orgs choose by default.
Devin: quick thought 4a1 Badges are useful, but mixing text badges and the pin creates visual noise. what about an overflow chevron for metrics on small rows?
Priya: a11y point — the pin control must expose aria-pressed and a visible focus outline at all densities. Also announce "Version X pinned" to SR when toggled.
Jordi: badge truncation is strange: we currently render "p50 18ms  cost $0.002" and it clips mid-token. either two-line badges or compress into icon+tooltip.
Sam: I vote icon+tooltip for compact. For medium show short text. For comfy show full text with legend.
Alex: idea: add a per-user density preference and a compare-level setting "Keep pinned column" which pins a dedicated column so badges never overlap the pin.
Marcy: keep-pinned-column sounds good but what about mobile responsiveness?
Devin: mobile flips to card stack; pinned column could become a sticky card header when stacked. need to prototype.
Priya: small copy tweak: change tooltip from "Pin version" to "Pin version to this comparison". also update SR text to "Version 1.2 pinned for comparison".
Jordi: color check: badge green (#25A85A) fails contrast at 12px. either darken color or add 1px inner stroke.
Sam: put a tiny icon set: latency (clock), throughput (bolt), quantized (Q). That saves horizontal space and keeps info scannable.
Alex: quick CSS experiment in staging to avoid overflow: ```css
.compare-row { height: 44px; }
.compare-row .metrics { display:flex; gap:6px; max-width:110px; }
.compare-row .metrics .text { overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
.pin-btn { position: absolute; right: 12px; }```
Marcy: absolute positioning might break table flow. sticky is better but file browser support ticket if we pick sticky.
Devin: product question: is pin global per user or ephemeral per comparison? We should decide.
Alex: Product proposal: ephemeral by default (view-scoped), with an opt-in "Save pinned versions" toggle persisted to account. Banner text: "Pins saved to this comparison" when ephemeral.
Priya: also add keyboard shortcut 'p' while row focused to toggle pin. add to keyboard shortcuts modal.
Jordi: can we run a short usability test A/B: medium default vs compact default with collapsed badges? metrics: time-to-pin, misclicks, and success finding pin.
Sam: will add analytics events: `catalog.pin_toggle`, `catalog.badge_collapsed`, and `catalog.density_changed` and wire to experiment.
Alex: ui-bot: staging build deployed at https://staging.redwood/compare (build 489). feature flags: `compare.density_pref` and `compare.collapse_metrics`. Please test keyboard, SR, and mobile stack. :rocket:
ui-bot: note: build 489 includes density pref + collapsed metrics behind `compare.collapse_metrics` (off).
Marcy: next steps: Alex iterate mock for pinned-column fallback, Priya to write the accessibility acceptance criteria, Sam to add analytics events and A/B plan, Devin to open cross-browser test ticket for sticky/absolute pin placement. I'll sync Tues. :calendar:
